Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.ui.gui.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Manages named root Parent nodes for the application's primary Stage.

Acts as a central registry for all JavaFX views used in the GUI (e.g. splash screen, main menu, game board, leaderboard), allowing other controllers such as MainMenuController and GameController to switch between them by name without holding direct references to the Stage.

Instead of swapping the entire Scene, this manager keeps a single permanent scene on the stage and swaps only the root Parent node. This avoids fullscreen glitches and resize flickers that occur when replacing the scene entirely.

Roots must be registered via register(String, Parent) before they can be activated with switchTo(String).

  • Method Details

    • register

      public void register(String name, javafx.scene.Parent root)
      Registers a root Parent node under the given name.

      If a root is already registered under the same name, it is replaced. Names should match the constants used by the GUI controllers when calling switchTo(String).

      Parameters:
      name - the unique identifier for the view (e.g. "game", "menu", "leaderboard")
      root - the root Parent node to associate with that name

    • switchTo

      public void switchTo(String name)
      Switches the primary stage to the root registered under the given name by replacing the current scene's root node.

      If no root is registered under name, the call is a no-op and the current scene remains unchanged.

      Parameters:
      name - the name of the view to display, as previously passed to register(String, Parent)
